name: SMPIT Masjid Syuhada Yogyakarta
address: Jl. I Dewa Nyoman Oka No.28, Kotabaru, Yogyakarta

source.title: 10 SMP Swasta Terbaik di Yogyakarta dengan Kisaran Biaya (KalderaNews)

notes.id: Dana pengembangan (sekali selama sekolah): gelombang inden Rp1.500.000; gelombang 1 Rp2.500.000 (potongan 50%); gelombang 2 Rp3.750.000 (potongan 25%); gelombang 3 Rp5.000.000. Biaya lain: Rp5.946.700 (putra) / Rp6.256.000 (putri).
notes.en: Development fund (once): early wave Rp1,500,000; wave 1 Rp2,500,000 (50% off); wave 2 Rp3,750,000 (25% off); wave 3 Rp5,000,000. Other costs: Rp5,946,700 (boys) / Rp6,256,000 (girls).

source.title: Pendaftaran Murid Baru SMP IT Masjid Syuhada TA 2027/2028 (situs resmi)

steps.id: Isi formulir pendaftaran SPMB 2027/2028 secara online.
steps.en: Fill in the SPMB 2027/2028 form online.

steps.id: Ikuti wawancara sesuai jadwal gelombang pendaftaran.
steps.en: Attend the interview on your wave's schedule.

steps.id: Bayar dana pengembangan dan biaya lain sesuai gelombang.
steps.en: Pay the development fund and other fees for your wave.

documents.id: Gelombang 3: fotokopi ijazah dan Surat Keterangan Nilai TKA (khusus DIY) yang dilegalisir, 1 lembar
documents.en: Wave 3: certified copies of the primary certificate and TKA score letter (DIY only), 1 each
